description: Eight unreviewed candidate claims spanning four intended categories. Intended labels are hypotheses for independent review, not golden factual oracles. Every current effective allowed outcome is UNVERIFIABLE.

cases.text: Earth is the third planet from the Sun.
cases.rationale_for_expected: Candidate interpretation, pending independent source and entailment review: NASA Earth Fact Sheet directly states Earth is the third planet from the Sun. Evidence source-01 directly supports this claim.

cases.text: Pluto is classified as a full planet by the International Astronomical Union.
cases.rationale_for_expected: Candidate interpretation, pending independent source and entailment review: IAU Resolution 5A (2006) reclassified Pluto as a 'dwarf planet', not a full planet. Evidence source-02 directly contradicts the claim.

cases.text: Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the Moon in 1969.
cases.rationale_for_expected: Candidate interpretation, pending independent source and entailment review: Smithsonian Apollo 11 overview confirms Armstrong and Aldrin landed on the Moon on July 20, 1969. Armstrong was first to step out. Source-03 supports the claim.

cases.text: The Great Wall of China is easily visible from space with the naked eye.
cases.rationale_for_expected: Candidate interpretation, pending independent source and entailment review: Britannica and astronaut reports confirm the Great Wall is NOT easily visible from space with the unaided eye. Evidence source-04 directly contradicts the claim.

cases.text: Everyone in the world has access to clean drinking water.
cases.rationale_for_expected: Candidate interpretation, pending independent source and entailment review: WHO reports 2.2 billion people lacked safely managed drinking water in 2022. Evidence source-05 directly contradicts the universal access claim.

cases.text: The ocean contains most of Earth's water, so almost all of Earth's water is freshwater.
cases.rationale_for_expected: Candidate MISLEADING interpretation: the claim combines an ocean-volume statement with a material inference about freshwater. Source-06 alone does not establish salinity or drinkability. Independent review and relevant source context are required before any confident label; only UNVERIFIABLE is allowed now.

Candidate interpretation, pending independent source and entailment review: No evidence supplied. Medical claim requires authoritative reviewed sources. Without evidence, only UNVERIFIABLE is valid per the grounding rule.

cases.text: A new species of deep-sea fish was discovered in the Mariana Trench in 2025.
cases.rationale_for_expected: Candidate interpretation, pending independent source and entailment review: No evidence supplied. Specific factual claim about a recent event requires sourced evidence. Without any supplied evidence, only UNVERIFIABLE is valid.
